author: serafimcloud
name: dotted-dialog
description:
A customized dialog component based on shadcn/ui Dialog with a dotted background pattern inspired by Motion.dev website.

Features:
	•	Dotted background pattern with blur effect
	•	Dark/light theme support
	•	Fully accessible (based on Radix UI)
	•	Smooth animations for open and close states
	•	Responsive design
	•	Includes all standard dialog components (header, footer, title, description)
